fusions.name: Tine Sweep
fusions.desc: Drags a stone tine across the target, dealing 5 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Windrow
fusions.desc: Sweeps the ground into a ring that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Heaped Berm
fusions.desc: Heaps a 6-tile berm of earth across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Gleaned Tempo
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
